messages:
olivia: Noticed a sharp reconnect spike on /v1/stream eu-west after the proxy canary (22:12). Clients report a 204 keepalive, then immediate reconnect. cc @mike @tanvi
mike: SSE. Any change to idle timeout on canary nodes?
otice-bot: Alert: stream.reconnect_rate /v1/stream eu-west > 4x baseline (22:10-22:22).
tanvi: Canary lowered idle from 100s -> 35s to free sockets faster. That will send 204s to clients. Some SDKs treat 204 as terminal and reopen immediately, causing duplicates.
ryan: Two quick mitigations: bump canary idle back to 90s; or enable per-route sticky sessions so resume tokens don't bounce across shards. I favour sticky for streaming.
mike: We also need console telemetry to split session_close reasons (proxy_204 vs client_drop vs runtime_close). Right now chart lumps them and hides the root cause. I'll add a low-cardinality tag `close_reason`.
tanvi: Rolling hotfix: set idle to 90s on canary + enable sticky_sessions=true for /v1/stream in canary pool. Deploying now.
deploy-bot: deploy success: proxy-config canary rollback partial -> v1.13.0 (2026-03-23T22:34:22Z).
olivia: Thanks. Please follow up with telemetry PR and a small console note that surfaces route idle_ms. We'll keep thread open until metrics normalize.
